Hi @{author}, thanks for the pull request!

Ardia takes pull requests from people a maintainer has vouched for, and you're not on the list yet, so this one has been closed for now.

If it doesn't close an issue yet, open one that says what you want to change and link it with `Closes #<issue>`. When a maintainer wants the change, they comment `vouch` here, which puts you on the list, and reopen this pull request. The details are in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/blob/{default_branch}/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests).
